annotations.text:
Drawn from production screenshots of Automotive - 4700, taken 2026-09-15. Every category, matrix and part number on these boards is real data from that shop.
Spec: Confluence 578781186, locked 2026-09-15.

Default rows do not move. Categories pins its Default row to the top and keeps doing so under every sort; Pricing matrices never pinned theirs and still does not. The two lists stay deliberately different, because that is what production does today.
Two of these three are the real work: a sort surviving a reload and a search share one code path today, and that path resets the sort.
